Poppy.build: Build armor first to withstand the main damage from Poppy Q Hammer Shock, E Heroic Charge, and R Keeper's Verdict. Poppy Q Hammer Shock deals damage based on your max health, so be careful about stacking health alone. Don't spend extra resources on magic resistance to deal with Poppy alone.
Poppy.teamfight: Don't engage with Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! while Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active. Charge along a path your allies can follow, keeping in mind that you charge at the first enemy champion you encounter. After engaging, even if Skaarl leaves, attack nearby enemies to build courage and try to remount.
Poppy.combo: After Poppy W Steadfast Presence ends and Poppy E Heroic Charge is down, close in with Kled E Jousting and land Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope. Stay close and follow with Kled W Violent Tendencies attacks; when the trap's pull triggers, finish the fourth hit. Keep in mind that recasting Kled E Jousting only moves you toward the target you first hit.
Poppy.escape: Right after Poppy uses E Heroic Charge is your chance to close the gap. Confirm that Poppy W Steadfast Presence has also ended, then engage with Kled E Jousting or Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! and land Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope. If Poppy E Heroic Charge is still available, she can leave the trap's range before it pulls her in.
Poppy.fight: Trade when Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope is ready and Skaarl has enough health. If Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, don't dash; wait for it to expire or walk in. Right after Poppy uses E Heroic Charge, close the gap with Kled E Jousting, land Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope, and stay close.
Poppy.laning: Fight in open space without a wall behind you to avoid being stunned by Poppy E Heroic Charge. If you can reach the shield dropped by Poppy P Iron Ambassador first, step on it to prevent her from getting the shield. Don't trade if Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope is unavailable or Skaarl has little health, and pressure the turret after winning a fight.
Poppy.phase: Kled is strong in lane early and in mid-game skirmishes, so turn your lead into turrets and objectives. The available information doesn't establish Poppy's relative strengths at different stages of the game. In the late game, Kled's sustained damage weakens if Skaarl leaves after he engages, so aim to avoid letting the game drag on.
Poppy.watch: When Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, dashing with Kled E Jousting or Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! will be stopped, and you also won't be able to use movement abilities for a short time. If Poppy E Heroic Charge pushes you into a wall, you'll be stunned, so stay in open space. If Poppy Q Hammer Shock hits you once, walk out of the area before its second blast. When Poppy spins her hammer to charge Poppy R Keeper's Verdict, move to the side rather than staying in front of her.

Aurora.fight: Trade when Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope is ready and Skaarl has enough health. Use Kled E Jousting to close in and force Aurora E The Weirding, then engage again with Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope and stay close to trigger the pull. If Aurora uses W Across the Veil to become invisible, do not waste abilities; watch where she reappears and keep your distance.
Aurora.escape: When both Aurora W Across the Veil and E The Weirding are down, close the gap with Kled E Jousting. If only one mobility spell is down, she can use the other to escape the trap, so do not rush your engage.
Aurora.laning: When Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope is down, do not force a fight; use Kled E Jousting to pull the wave and keep it near your side. Avoid fighting if Skaarl is low, and quickly build courage while dismounted when you can attack a champion. After winning a trade, press your advantage by taking Turret Plating.
Aurora.teamfight: Start teamfights with Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! along a path your allies can follow. Use the shield during the charge to withstand damage right after engaging. Even if Skaarl leaves, attack enemies to build courage and try to remount. If Aurora dives in with W Across the Veil but fails to kill anyone, look for a chance to catch her again. When retreating, do not leave low-health allies behind.
Aurora.build: Start with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Aurora deals mostly magic damage and Kled has low magic resistance, so fit Maw of Malmortius between your core items for resistance and a shield. If Aurora P Spirit Abjuration’s healing keeps her alive even after Kled W Violent Tendencies’ fourth hit, build Executioner’s Calling earlier.
Aurora.combo: Close in with Kled E Jousting, land Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope, then use Kled W Violent Tendencies’ fast attacks to stay close. Keep on the target until the trap pulls and land the fourth hit. If Aurora W Across the Veil, E The Weirding, or R Between Worlds takes her out of the trap’s range, the pull will break, so start this sequence while her mobility is down.
Aurora.phase: Kled is strong in lane and in midgame skirmishes, so turn your early lead into Turret Plating and your midgame lead into turrets and objectives. In late-game teamfights, his sustained damage falls off if Skaarl leaves early, so avoid letting the game go long.
Aurora.watch: Aurora Q Twofold Hex deals damage again when recalled, and that damage increases with your missing health. If you are cursed, move out of the line between you and Aurora, and retreat before the recall if your health is low. After Aurora R Between Worlds creates its field, leaving slows you, so either get out before it forms or commit to fighting inside it.

Akali.teamfight: Start teamfights with Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! along a path your allies can follow. Skaarl charges the first enemy champion in its path, so choose your route carefully. Even if Skaarl leaves after you engage, do not immediately retreat; attack enemies to build courage and try to remount.
Akali.laning: Treat Skaarl’s health as your own, and do not trade when it is low. While Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope is down, use Kled E Jousting to pull the wave and keep it near your side. Build a health and CS lead while Akali R Perfect Execution is down, and pressure Turret Plating when you win a fight.
Akali.build: Survive the early game with a Null-Magic Mantle, and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Akali deals mostly magic damage and Kled has low magic resistance, so fit Maw of Malmortius between your core items. Build health along with magic resistance to stay out of Akali R Perfect Execution’s execute range.
Akali.combo: When Akali’s mobility is down, close in with Kled E Jousting and land Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope. Stay close and land all four Kled W Violent Tendencies attacks, finishing the fourth hit when the trap pulls her in. Account for the fact that Kled E Jousting can only be recast toward the target it first hit when deciding whether to chase or disengage.
Akali.escape: After dodging Akali E Shuriken Flip’s first projectile and waiting for Akali W Twilight Shroud to go down, look for an opening to engage. If only one mobility spell is down, Akali can still use another to escape Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope’s range, so especially look to engage before Akali R Perfect Execution comes back up. Then close the gap with Kled E Jousting or Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!!.
Akali.fight: Fight only when Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope is ready. After landing the trap, use Kled E Jousting and basic attacks to stay close until it pulls. Akali can use W Twilight Shroud, E Shuriken Flip, or R Perfect Execution to create distance and break the tether, so track her remaining mobility.
Akali.phase: Kled is strong in lane and in midgame skirmishes, so turn your lead into turrets and objectives. In late-game teamfights, his sustained damage falls off after Skaarl leaves, so avoid letting the game go long.
Akali.watch: Prioritize dodging the first projectile from Akali E Shuriken Flip. If its mark lands, the second dash will follow you even if you run away. You cannot dodge Akali R Perfect Execution’s first dash on foot, so save Kled E Jousting and use it when she engages. Akali R Perfect Execution’s second hit deals more damage based on your missing health.

Camille.laning: Stand among minions and away from walls to make it harder for Camille E Hookshot to engage from a wall. When Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope is down, avoid trading; use Kled E Jousting to keep the wave near your side and basic attacks to reduce Kled W Violent Tendencies’ cooldown. Take the initiative before Camille completes her first core item, and turn winning fights into turret pressure.
Camille.teamfight: Use Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! along a path your allies can follow, accounting for the fact that Kled charges the first enemy champion along its route. Even if Skaarl leaves after you engage, keep attacking during the fight to build courage and try to remount. If Camille traps you with Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum, do not waste crowd control during the engage; counterattack after the zone ends.
Camille.build: Build armor first against Camille’s main damage. However, armor cannot reduce the true damage from Camille Q Precision Protocol, and Camille W Tactical Sweep deals damage based on your max health, so be careful about stacking health alone. If Camille W Tactical Sweep’s healing keeps her alive even after Kled W Violent Tendencies’ fourth hit, build Executioner’s Calling earlier.
Camille.combo: First check whether Camille can escape with Camille E Hookshot or Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum. To engage, close in with Kled E Jousting and land Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope. Keep attacking with Kled W Violent Tendencies while staying close. When the pull triggers, finish with Kled W Violent Tendencies’ fourth hit.
Camille.escape: Look for an opening after interrupting Camille E Hookshot’s dash or before Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum comes back up. Do not rush in just because one of those mobility spells is down; check the remaining option too, then close the gap with Kled E Jousting or Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! and land Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope.
Camille.fight: Avoid trading right after Camille P Adaptive Defenses grants her a shield. When the shield wears off, start a fight with Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope. After landing the trap, use Kled E Jousting to stay close and trigger the pull, then land Kled W Violent Tendencies’ fourth hit. If you are dismounted, look for a chance to attack her and build courage to remount instead of running away blindly.
Camille.phase: Kled has strong trades early, while Camille is weak before her first core item, so look for lane control and turret pressure. Midgame skirmishes are a strength for Kled, but do not leave Camille’s side lane turret pressure unchecked. Kled’s sustained damage falls off after he dismounts late, so turn your midgame lead into turrets and objectives.
Camille.watch: Camille E Hookshot is a stun engage that starts from a wall, so stand away from walls. When her hook catches a wall, look for a chance to interrupt her dash with Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope’s pull. Camille Q Precision Protocol’s second empowered attack deals true damage, so create distance while she prepares it. Do not waste your response when Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum engages; if you are trapped, counterattack after the zone ends.

Fiora.laning: Stand opposite the vital indicated by Fiora P Duelist’s Dance and counterattack when she dashes toward it. Do not trade when Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope is down; use Kled E Jousting to keep the wave near your side. If Skaarl is low, retreat first to build courage, and pressure the turret if you win a trade.
Fiora.teamfight: Check whether Fiora W Riposte has been used, then engage with Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! along a path your allies can follow. Even if Skaarl leaves, attack enemies to build courage and try to remount. If Fiora R Grand Challenge targets you, stand against a wall so she cannot reach all four vitals.
Fiora.build: Build armor first against Fiora Q Lunge and E Bladework. Armor cannot block the true damage from Fiora P Duelist’s Dance or R Grand Challenge.
Fiora.combo: Bait out Fiora W Riposte and wait for Fiora Q Lunge to be down, then close in with Kled E Jousting and land Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope. Stay close and use basic attacks to land all four Kled W Violent Tendencies attacks while triggering the trap’s pull. If Kled E Jousting hits Fiora, you can recast it to move.
Fiora.escape: Right after Fiora Q Lunge is down is an opportunity to engage with Kled E Jousting and land Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope. If Fiora W Riposte is also down, she is less likely to block the trap’s pull or stun you in response.
Fiora.fight: After baiting Fiora Q Lunge, close the gap with Kled E Jousting. Draw out Fiora W Riposte first, then land Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope and stay close to trigger the pull and land Kled W Violent Tendencies’ fourth hit. Do not overchase after a short trade.
Fiora.phase: Kled is a champion who snowballs leads from lane and midgame skirmishes. Turn the advantages you gain during this period into turrets and objectives.
Fiora.watch: If Fiora Q Lunge takes her out of the trap’s range, the pull will not trigger, so check whether she uses it. If Fiora R Grand Challenge targets you, stand against a wall to block one of the vital directions.

Gwen.laning: Early on, trade when Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope is ready, before Gwen has built up stacks with basic attacks. If Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope is unavailable, use Kled E Jousting to pull the wave and keep it on your side, and use basic attacks to reduce Kled W Violent Tendencies’ cooldown. Avoid fighting if Skaarl is low on health. After winning a trade, pressure the turret.
Gwen.combo: After Gwen E Skip 'n Slash is down, engage with Kled E Jousting and land Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope. Stay close and keep attacking with Kled W Violent Tendencies. When the trap’s pull triggers, finish the fourth hit. If Kled E Jousting has hit the enemy, you can recast it to move toward the same target, so use it with your escape route in mind.
Gwen.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first early on and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Prioritize magic resistance against Gwen’s main magic damage, and fit Maw of Malmortius between core items to give yourself a chance to survive after being dismounted. If Gwen P A Thousand Cuts’ healing makes it hard to finish her even with Kled W Violent Tendencies’ fourth hit, rush Executioner's Calling.
Gwen.escape: The window to engage is right after Gwen E Skip 'n Slash is down. Close the gap with Kled E Jousting or Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! and land Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope to make it hard for Gwen to escape. Check your approach and distance rather than recklessly chasing through the slow from Gwen R Needlework.
Gwen.fight: Right after you make Gwen use E Skip 'n Slash, close the gap with Kled E Jousting and land Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope. Stay close while the trap is active to trigger its pull, and trade when you can get in Kled W Violent Tendencies’ fourth hit. Move sideways out of the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!.
Gwen.phase: Early on, Kled has a chance to trade before Gwen builds stacks with basic attacks. Kled is strong in lane and in midgame skirmishes, so turn any advantage into turrets and objectives. In late-game team fights, his sustained damage drops off after he is dismounted, so play to avoid letting the game drag on.
Gwen.teamfight: Use Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! along a path your allies can follow to start a team fight. Use the shield gained while charging to withstand damage right after engaging, and keep in mind that you charge the first enemy champion you encounter along the path. Even after being dismounted, stay close and attack to build Courage and look to remount. Avoid the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!.
Gwen.watch: Move sideways to dodge the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!, which deals true damage. If Gwen uses E Skip 'n Slash to get out of Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope’s range, the pull will not trigger, so it is better to set the trap after Gwen E Skip 'n Slash is down. When Gwen W Hallowed Mist is active, she cannot be targeted from outside the mist, so go inside or wait for it to end.

KSante.laning: Avoid fighting if Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope is unavailable or Skaarl has little health, and keep the lane on your side. After winning a trade, maintain your advantage by pressuring Turret Plating.
KSante.build: Prioritize armor penetration against K'Sante's high armor. Build armor rather than magic resistance to withstand his attacks, and use health to survive the true damage from K'Sante W Path Maker.
KSante.combo: Hit K'Sante with Kled E Jousting to close in, then land Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope and follow with Kled W Violent Tendencies attacks. Stay close to land the trap's pull and your fourth attack before K'Sante can disengage. Remember that recasting Kled E Jousting moves you toward the K'Sante you first hit.
KSante.escape: Look to engage after both K'Sante W Path Maker and E Footwork are down, before K'Sante R All Out is available again. If K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes' shockwave is ready, dodge it from outside its range or hold Kled E Jousting. After engaging, land Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope and stay close so K'Sante can't leave its range.
KSante.fight: After K'Sante W Path Maker and E Footwork are down, close in with Kled E Jousting and land Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope. Stay close while the trap is attached to trigger its pull, and get all four attacks of Kled W Violent Tendencies. When K'Sante R All Out is active and his armor is reduced, focus your damage, but don't try to withstand his increased damage and life steal alone.
KSante.phase: K'Sante becomes difficult to fight in lane as he builds defensive items, so Kled should turn his early lead into Turret Plating and mid-game objectives. Kled's sustained damage is weaker in late-game teamfights, so aim to end the game in the mid game.
KSante.teamfight: Use Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! along a path your allies can follow so they can engage with you. If K'Sante W Path Maker is charging, move away from its direction, and focus your damage with allies when K'Sante R All Out reduces his armor. Even if Skaarl leaves, attack nearby enemies to build courage and try to remount.
KSante.watch: If you get hit by K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes in succession, step out of range to dodge the next shockwave or hold Kled E Jousting. When K'Sante W Path Maker is charging, wait for its unstoppable state and damage reduction to end while moving to the side of its charge path. Do not keep a wall behind you, so K'Sante R All Out cannot knock you over it.

Malphite.teamfight: Spread out from your allies so Malphite R Unstoppable Force can't knock up several of you at once, and don't give him an engage angle if his location is unknown. Once his ultimate is down, use Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! along a path your allies can follow and engage together. Even if Skaarl leaves, don't retreat immediately; attack enemies to build courage and try to remount.
Malphite.watch: If Malphite Q Seismic Shard hits you, its slow makes it difficult to engage or disengage, so don't start a trade right afterward. Before using basic attacks, check whether Malphite E Ground Slam, which reduces attack speed, is down. Malphite R Unstoppable Force can't be interrupted, so don't group with allies when you don't know where he is.
Malphite.laning: Break Malphite P Granite Shield and poke at short intervals to stop it from returning. While Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope is unavailable, use Kled E Jousting to pull the wave and keep the lane on your side. Turn winning trades into turret pressure.
Malphite.build: Malphite's primary damage is magic, so buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads. Fit Maw of Malmortius between your core items so you can survive even after Skaarl leaves. Against Malphite's high armor, it's important to land all of Kled W Violent Tendencies' max-health damage.
Malphite.combo: Break Malphite P Granite Shield first, then close in with Kled E Jousting and land Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope. Stay close and land Kled W Violent Tendencies attacks; when the trap's pull triggers, finish the fourth hit. Kled E Jousting's recast only moves toward the target you first hit, so check your escape route before using it.
Malphite.escape: If Malphite E Ground Slam is also down, close the gap with Kled E Jousting, catch him with Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope, and keep up your basic attacks.
Malphite.fight: Break Malphite P Granite Shield first, then trade when Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope is ready. After Malphite E Ground Slam is down, close in with Kled E Jousting and stay in range until the trap's pull triggers. If Malphite R Unstoppable Force is still available, he can get out of the trap's range, so don't chase recklessly.
Malphite.phase: Early on, Kled can take control when Malphite's ultimate is unavailable and look for kills and Turret Plating. Turn that lead into turrets and objectives in the mid game.

Nasus.teamfight: Use Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! along a path your allies can follow so they can engage with you. While Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active, don't face him head-on; keep your distance and let its duration run out. If Skaarl leaves after you engage, attack enemies to build courage and try to remount.
Nasus.laning: Keep the wave on your side instead of pushing it under Nasus's turret, pressuring him so he can't stack Nasus Q Siphoning Strike safely. Nasus has no escape besides Flash, so call your jungler to gank from this position. Turn winning trades into turret pressure.
Nasus.build: Build armor first against Nasus's primary damage, Q Siphoning Strike. Nasus E Spirit Fire and R Fury of the Sands deal magic damage, which armor alone can't block, and R deals damage based on your max health, so avoid choices that greatly increase health alone.
Nasus.combo: Hit Nasus with Kled E Jousting to close in, then land Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope. Follow with Kled W Violent Tendencies attacks and stay close until Q's pull triggers, then finish the fourth hit. Kled E Jousting's recast moves toward the target you first hit, so check its direction when disengaging.
Nasus.escape: Look to engage with Kled E Jousting after Nasus W Wither is down and R Fury of the Sands has ended. Nasus has no way to create distance besides Flash, so catch him with Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope and follow through until it pulls.
Nasus.fight: Close in with Kled E Jousting, land Q, then stay close to trigger the pull and land Kled W Violent Tendencies' fourth hit. Don't force continued attacks if Nasus W Wither affects you or R Fury of the Sands is active.
Nasus.phase: Turn your mid-game lead into turrets and objectives. Nasus grows stronger as he stacks, while Kled is weaker in extended late-game fights, so don't let the game drag on.
Nasus.watch: Nasus W Wither reduces movement and attack speed, disrupting Kled W Violent Tendencies' attacks, so don't fight alone while affected. Nasus E Spirit Fire reduces your armor, so move out of the area. When Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active, avoid fighting unless you have a clear numbers or damage advantage, and let its duration run out.

Rumble.laning: Fight where Rumble has to walk forward, reducing your exposure to Rumble Q Flamespitter. When Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope is unavailable, avoid fighting and use Kled E Jousting to keep the wave on your side. Pressure the turret if you win the trade, and back off first if Skaarl is very low on health.
Rumble.build: Rumble's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. Start with a Null-Magic Mantle to survive the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Fit a Maw of Malmortius, which provides a shield and magic resistance, between your core items.
Rumble.combo: Close in on Rumble with Kled E Jousting and land Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope. Stay close and attack with Kled W Violent Tendencies; when the trap's pull triggers, finish the fourth attack. Keep in mind that Kled E Jousting's recast only goes toward the first target it hit.
Rumble.escape: The window to engage opens when Rumble W Scrap Shield's shield and movement speed bonus end. If the first shot of Rumble E Electro Harpoon hits you, dodge the second with Kled E Jousting before it arrives. After dodging the harpoon, catch Rumble with Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope.
Rumble.fight: Trade when Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope is ready and Skaarl has enough health. If Rumble activates Rumble W Scrap Shield, hold your burst damage while the shield lasts briefly, then close in with Kled E Jousting after it expires. After landing the trap, stay close to trigger its pull and get in Kled W Violent Tendencies' fourth attack.
Rumble.phase: Kled is strong in the early lane and in midgame skirmishes, so turn the advantage you gain then into turret and objective pressure. In late-game teamfights, Skaarl is likely to leave after you engage, and your damage to champions while dismounted is lower. Aim to secure the game in the midgame.
Rumble.teamfight: Use Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! along a path your allies can follow to engage together. Use the shield during the charge to withstand damage just after engaging. Even if Skaarl leaves, attack enemies to build Courage and look to remount.

Skarner.laning: Trade when Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope is back. Fight in open space so Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact cannot push you into a wall, and when Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope is unavailable, use Kled E Jousting to pull the wave toward your side. If Skaarl is low on health, back off first and build courage; turn trades you win into turret pressure.
Skarner.teamfight: Use Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! along a path your allies can follow so you can engage together. Skaarl charges at the first enemy champion in its path, so do not plan a route that passes Skarner to reach the backline. Even if Skaarl dismounts, attack nearby enemies to build courage and aim to remount, but keep track of the distance between Skarner and his allies so Skarner R Impale does not drag you into the enemy team.
Skarner.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Build magic resistance first against Skarner’s main damage, while also accounting for the physical damage from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact. If you need a way to remove the suppression from Skarner R Impale, consider Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar.
Skarner.combo: When Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact is down, close in with Kled E Jousting and land Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope. Stay close and attack with Kled W Violent Tendencies; after the trap’s pull triggers, finish the fourth hit. Use Kled E Jousting’s recast knowing it only heads toward the target it first hit.
Skarner.escape: The window to engage with Kled E Jousting or Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! is right after Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact is down. If you are stunned by a wall collision, Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact will come back up sooner, so back off with the next engage in mind.
Skarner.fight: Right after you bait out Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact, close in with Kled E Jousting and land Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope. Stay close while the trap is attached and get in Kled W Violent Tendencies’ fourth attack. Do not rush your engage while Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact is available, since he can use it to get out of the trap’s range.
Skarner.phase: Early on, use Kled’s strong trades to gain an advantage and delay Skarner’s item timings. While Kled is strong in the midgame, secure your lead with turrets and objectives. In late-game team fights, sustained damage weakens after you are dismounted from Skaarl, so play to avoid letting the game drag on.
Skarner.watch: Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact stuns only if it hits a wall, so do not stand with your back to one. Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval’s empowered basic attack and Skarner P Threads of Vibration are dangerous when you are close, so do not let him get into melee range unless you are ready to fight. Kled E Jousting cannot break the suppression from Skarner R Impale.

Tryndamere.laning: Early on, harass Tryndamere when he goes for last hits to keep him from building Fury. Trade when Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope is back, and when it is unavailable, use Kled E Jousting to keep the wave on your side. Do not start a fight if Skaarl is low on health, and pressure the turret if you win the trade.
Tryndamere.teamfight: Use Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! along a path your allies can follow. If Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, do not focus your damage on him; create distance and run out its duration. Even if Skaarl dismounts after you engage, attack an enemy to build courage and aim to remount.
Tryndamere.build: Tryndamere’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. If healing from Tryndamere Q Bloodlust means you still cannot finish him with Kled W Violent Tendencies’ percent-max-health damage, get Executioner’s Calling earlier. Consider Thornmail when you need to counter his reliance on basic attacks.
Tryndamere.combo: After Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is down, close in with Kled E Jousting and land Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope. Stay close and attack with Kled W Violent Tendencies; when the pull triggers, finish the fourth hit. Kled E Jousting’s recast only heads toward the target it first hit, so use it while checking your direction of travel.
Tryndamere.escape: Your window to engage is right after Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is used. Close the distance with Kled E Jousting or Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! and land Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope to limit his chance to move. After being hit by Tryndamere W Mocking Shout, avoid trading basic attacks; when backing off, walk backward while facing Tryndamere to avoid the slow.
Tryndamere.fight: Right after you bait out Tryndamere E Spinning Slash, close in with Kled E Jousting and land Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope. Stay close while the trap is attached to trigger the pull, and get in Kled W Violent Tendencies’ fourth hit. When Tryndamere R Undying Rage activates, stop attacking and create distance; fight again after its duration ends.
Tryndamere.phase: Kled is strong in lane and in midgame skirmishes, so turn your early advantage into turret pressure and target turrets and objectives in the midgame. In late-game team fights, sustained damage weakens if you are dismounted from Skaarl after Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! engages. Play to secure your midgame lead instead of letting the game drag on.
Tryndamere.watch: When Tryndamere attacks minions to build Fury, watch out for the critical strikes from Tryndamere P Battle Fury and healing from Tryndamere Q Bloodlust. If Tryndamere E Spinning Slash gets him out of Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope’s range, the pull will not trigger. When Tryndamere R Undying Rage activates, do not dump your damage; create distance and let its duration run out.

Volibear.teamfight: Use Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! along a path your team can follow, keeping in mind that it charges at the first enemy champion in its path. If Volibear has stacks of passive P The Relentless Storm, engage after they expire. Even if you are dismounted after you engage, don’t retreat right away; attack enemies to build courage and aim to remount.
Volibear.laning: While Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope is unavailable, use Kled E Jousting to keep the wave on your side; look for a chance to fight when Q comes back. If you win a trade, extend your advantage with turret pressure.
Volibear.build: If Volibear W Frenzied Maul’s healing makes him hard to finish even with Kled W Violent Tendencies’ fourth hit, get Executioner’s Calling earlier. Build armor first against Volibear’s main damage sources: Q Thundering Smash, W Frenzied Maul, and R Stormbringer.
Volibear.combo: After Volibear’s mobility ability is down, close in with Kled E Jousting and hit Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope. Stay close and land basic attacks with Kled W Violent Tendencies; after Q’s pull triggers, finish the fourth hit. Kled E Jousting’s recast targets the first unit it hit, so use it with Volibear’s position in mind.
Volibear.escape: If only Volibear Q Thundering Smash is down, he can escape Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope with R Stormbringer, so don’t rush your engage. Close the gap with Kled E Jousting or R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! during the window when both Volibear Q Thundering Smash and R Stormbringer are down and Q’s stun is unavailable.
Volibear.fight: Don’t fight Volibear while he has stacks of attack speed from his passive P The Relentless Storm; fight after the stacks expire and when Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope is ready. Avoid long fights that give him room to heal with Volibear W Frenzied Maul, and land Kled W Violent Tendencies’ fourth hit when you can finish him. Move to the side to avoid Volibear E Sky Splitter’s mark, then go back in.
Volibear.phase: Use Kled’s strong trades early, but base fights on Skaarl’s health and whether Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope is ready. Kled is strongest in lane and in mid-game skirmishes, so turn your advantage into turret pressure and objectives. In late game, sustained damage drops after engaging with Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! and being dismounted from Skaarl, so play to avoid dragging the game out.
Volibear.watch: Volibear Q Thundering Smash quickly closes in and stuns with a basic attack, so let time pass from outside his attack range. When the mark from Volibear E Sky Splitter appears, move to the side to avoid the damage and slow, and watch where Volibear is trying to receive the shield. If Volibear R Stormbringer is ready, don’t stay under your turret at low health; retreat deep inside.

Illaoi.laning: Keep the wave away from walls and last-hit from outside Illaoi E Test of Spirit’s range. Do not trade while Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope is unavailable; use Kled E Jousting to pull the wave and keep it on your side. If you win the trade, extend your advantage by pressuring the turret.
Illaoi.teamfight: Destroy tentacles when you can; otherwise, draw Illaoi away from the wall. Use Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! along a path your allies can follow, but if Illaoi uses R Leap of Faith, spread out to wait out her brief damage window. When fighting again afterward, keep attacking enemies to build Courage and look to remount even if you are dismounted.
Illaoi.build: If Illaoi heals with P Prophet of an Elder God and withstands Kled W Violent Tendencies’ fourth hit, rush Executioner's Calling. Illaoi’s main damage is physical, and Illaoi W Harsh Lesson deals damage based on your max health, so build armor first instead of stacking health alone.
Illaoi.combo: Right after Illaoi uses W Harsh Lesson, engage with Kled E Jousting and land Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope. Keep attacking with Kled W Violent Tendencies, trigger the trap’s pull, and finish the fourth hit. If Illaoi creates distance, you can use Kled E Jousting’s recast to re-engage on the target you first hit.
Illaoi.escape: Engage after dodging Illaoi E Test of Spirit and after she has used Illaoi W Harsh Lesson. Then close the gap with Kled E Jousting or R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! and set Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope to limit her chance to escape.
Illaoi.fight: Right after Illaoi uses W Harsh Lesson is an opportunity to close the gap. After dodging Illaoi E Test of Spirit, if Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope is ready, engage with Kled E Jousting and set the trap. Stay close until its pull triggers and get in Kled W Violent Tendencies’ fourth hit.
Illaoi.phase: Kled has strong early trading in lane, but do not start a fight when Skaarl is low on health. Convert your advantage in lane and midgame skirmishes into turrets and objectives. In the late game, Kled’s sustained damage drops off after engaging with R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! and being dismounted, so aim to secure the game during midgame.
Illaoi.watch: If you are hit by Illaoi E Test of Spirit, you will be marked, so last-hit from outside its range and engage after dodging it. When Illaoi uses R Leap of Faith, her brief high-damage window begins, so spread out to reduce the number of targets hit. Illaoi can heal with P Prophet of an Elder God near walls with tentacles, so do not fight there.

Kayle.laning: While Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope is unavailable, use Kled E Jousting to keep the wave on your side and prepare for the next fight. Pressure the turret after winning a trade, and engage with your jungler after Kayle gains ranged attack range.
Kayle.watch: Kayle Q Radiant Blast slows and reduces armor and magic resistance, so dodge the direct hit before engaging. Kayle W Celestial Blessing can heal her and increase her movement speed, so after landing Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope, stay close until its pull triggers. While Kayle R Divine Judgment is active, don't unload your damage; hold her with the pull until her invulnerability ends.
Kayle.teamfight: Use Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! along a flank that reaches Kayle and that your allies can follow. It charges at the first enemy champion on its path, so find an angle that avoids the frontline and time it so your allies' crowd control lands as you reach Kayle. If Kayle R Divine Judgment activates, wait out her invulnerability with the pull from Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope or Kled E Jousting, then attack.
Kayle.build: Use a Null-Magic Mantle to withstand early damage and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Kayle deals mostly magic damage and Kled has low magic resistance, so fit Maw of Malmortius between your core items. If Kayle W Celestial Blessing's healing means your fourth Kled W Violent Tendencies hit still won't finish her, buy Executioner's Calling earlier.
Kayle.combo: Close in on Kayle with Kled E Jousting and land Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope. Follow with Kled W Violent Tendencies attacks and stay close until the trap's pull triggers, then finish the fourth hit. When Kayle R Divine Judgment activates, don't focus damage into her invulnerability; wait it out with the trap's pull, then attack again.
Kayle.escape: Kayle has no mobility spell, so use Kled E Jousting to engage when Kayle Q Radiant Blast misses or is down and you won't be slowed. Land Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope before Kayle can increase her movement speed with W Celestial Blessing, and stay close until the pull triggers. After Kayle R Divine Judgment is down, engage again without worrying about her invulnerability.
Kayle.fight: Close in with Kled E Jousting, land the trap, and stay close until Kled W Violent Tendencies' fourth hit before Kayle can escape with W Celestial Blessing. If Kayle R Divine Judgment is already down, engage again and focus your damage.

Olaf.laning: Don't initiate a fight when Skaarl has little health, so Olaf can't get an early kill. Avoid the side where Olaf Q Undertow's axe lands, and keep the lane on your side while Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope is unavailable. If you win the trade, pressure the turret to build your lead.
Olaf.teamfight: Use Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! along a path your allies can follow to start the teamfight. It charges at the first enemy champion it encounters, so consider both your target and entry path. During Olaf R Ragnarok, don't rely on Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope's pull; even if Skaarl leaves, attack enemies to build courage and try to remount.
Olaf.phase: Olaf is strong early and becomes relatively weaker as the game goes on. Kled is strong in lane and in mid-game skirmishes, so avoid giving up an early kill, then grow your lead with turrets and objectives in the mid game. Kled's sustained damage also weakens in the late game, so don't let the game drag on.
Olaf.build: Build armor first against Olaf Q Undertow and his basic attacks. Olaf E Reckless Swing deals true damage that resistances can't reduce, so also build health. Consider effects that reduce his attack speed so you take fewer basic attacks.
Olaf.combo: After Olaf R Ragnarok ends, close in with Kled E Jousting and land Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope. Stay close and follow with Kled W Violent Tendencies attacks; when the trap's pull triggers, finish the fourth hit. Keep in mind that recasting Kled E Jousting only moves you toward the target you first hit.
Olaf.escape: Olaf has no skill to create distance on his own, so look for an opening after dodging Olaf Q Undertow and blocking his path to retrieve the axe. If Olaf R Ragnarok is active, create distance and let its duration run out; after it ends, catch him with Kled E Jousting and Q Bear Trap on a Rope.
Olaf.fight: Trade when Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope is ready and Skaarl has enough health. Dodge Olaf Q Undertow and move out of the axe's retrieval path, then close in with Kled E Jousting and stay in range until the trap's pull triggers. Even when Olaf's health is low, his attack speed and life steal increase, so don't fight for too long.
Olaf.watch: Olaf Q Undertow reduces Kled's armor and slows him, so dodge the axe and move opposite its landing direction to prevent Olaf from retrieving it. Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope's pull doesn't work during Olaf R Ragnarok, so create distance and use it after his ultimate ends. Olaf E Reckless Swing deals true damage that armor can't reduce, so be especially careful when your health is low.

Quinn.build: Build armor first against Quinn's damage. The damage from Quinn P Harrier, Quinn Q Blinding Assault, and Quinn E Vault is all physical, so don't prioritize magic resistance for this matchup.
Quinn.teamfight: Use Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! along a path your allies can follow to engage together. If Quinn comes in from the side, look for a chance to catch her with Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope. Even if Skaarl leaves, don't immediately retreat; attack enemies to build Courage and look to remount.
Quinn.combo: After Quinn E Vault is down, hit her with Kled E Jousting and cast Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope. Stay close and keep attacking with Kled W Violent Tendencies; when the trap's pull triggers, finish the fourth attack. If Quinn creates distance, recast Kled E Jousting toward the target it already hit.
Quinn.escape: The window to engage opens immediately after Quinn uses Quinn E Vault. Close the gap then with Kled E Jousting or Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! and catch her with Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope.
Quinn.fight: When Quinn E Vault is down, close in with Kled E Jousting and land Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope. Stay close while the trap holds her and get in Kled W Violent Tendencies' fourth attack.
Quinn.laning: Early on, respect Quinn's range, preserve your health, and collect CS. Look to trade when Quinn P Harrier isn't marking you and Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope is ready, but don't force an engage alone while Quinn E Vault is available. Pressure the turret if you win the trade.
Quinn.phase: In the early lane, Quinn pressures you with her range, so preserve your health and wait for Quinn E Vault to go down. Kled is strong in lane and in midgame skirmishes, so turn your advantage into turret and objective pressure.
Quinn.watch: When Quinn P Harrier marks you, move out of range so you don't take the empowered attack. Quinn E Vault interrupts Kled's engage and lets her retreat backward, so don't force your way in before it's down. Stand so minions take Quinn Q Blinding Assault first, and don't throw skillshots if your vision is reduced.

Sett.laning: When Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope is unavailable, avoid fighting and use Kled E Jousting to keep the wave on your side. Don't start a fight if Skaarl is very low on health. If you win a trade, extend your advantage by pressuring the turret.
Sett.build: Build armor first to reduce the damage from Sett P Pit Grit and Sett Q Knuckle Down. Since basic attacks and attack speed are central to his damage, lowering his attack speed is also effective. Sett W Haymaker's center deals true damage that resistances can't reduce, and stacking health alone also increases the damage from Sett Q Knuckle Down, so prioritize movement that avoids the center.
Sett.combo: Close in on Sett with Kled E Jousting and land Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope. Stay close and attack with Kled W Violent Tendencies; after the trap's pull triggers, finish the fourth attack. When Sett W Haymaker comes out, move to the side of its center and use Kled E Jousting's recast to manage your distance.
Sett.escape: Once Sett E Facebreaker is down, you can engage without being stunned by it. If Sett R The Show Stopper is available, keep in mind he can use the dash to get out of range while the trap is attached.
Sett.fight: Trade with Sett when Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope is ready. Close in with Kled E Jousting, land the trap, and stay close to get Kled W Violent Tendencies' fourth attack. After dealing damage, avoid the center of Sett W Haymaker, then close in again when his Grit cools down.
Sett.phase: Kled is strong in lane and in midgame skirmishes, so snowball the advantage you gain then into turret and objective pressure. In late-game teamfights, sustained damage weakens if Skaarl leaves after you engage, so play to close out the game before it drags on.
Sett.teamfight: Use Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! along a path your allies can follow to start a teamfight. It charges at the first enemy champion along its path, so choose your entry route carefully, and use the shield to absorb the damage that comes just after you engage. Fight while avoiding the center of Sett W Haymaker; even if Skaarl leaves, attack nearby enemies to build Courage and look to remount.
Sett.watch: Sett W Haymaker is dangerous just after Sett has taken a lot of damage, so after dealing heavy damage, briefly create distance and wait for his Grit to cool down. If you can't avoid it, step to the side of the center of its aim to dodge the true damage. Sett E Facebreaker stuns if it catches enemies on both sides of Sett, so don't get caught between him and a group of minions.

Yasuo.laning: Try to trade when Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope is back. Keeping a thin wave on your side gives Yasuo fewer minions to approach with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. Avoid fighting if Skaarl is low on health, and pressure the turret if you win a trade.
Yasuo.build: Yasuo Q Steel Tempest and Yasuo R Last Breath deal his main physical damage, so build armor first. Armor does not reduce the magic damage from Yasuo E Sweeping Blade.
Yasuo.combo: Remove Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield first, then close in with Kled E Jousting and hit Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope. Stay close and land four basic attacks with Kled W Violent Tendencies, following Yasuo E Sweeping Blade’s movement so the pull triggers. Kled E Jousting’s recast only moves toward the first target it hit, so check that direction when using it to disengage as well.
Yasuo.escape: The chance to engage comes right after Yasuo Q Steel Tempest’s tornado is down. Before Yasuo R Last Breath comes off cooldown, account for Yasuo E Sweeping Blade’s movement, close the gap with Kled E Jousting or Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!!, and use Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope.
Yasuo.fight: Go in right after Yasuo’s tornado is down. First use light poke to remove Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield, then, after hitting Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope, stay close with Kled E Jousting so Yasuo can’t create distance with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade.
Yasuo.phase: Kled is strong in early lane and mid-game skirmishes, so turn your advantage during this time into turret pressure and objectives. In late game, sustained damage drops after engaging with Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! and being dismounted from Skaarl, so play to avoid dragging the game out.
Yasuo.teamfight: Use Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! along a path your team can follow to engage together. It charges at the first enemy champion in its path, so check the route to your target before using it. Even if you are dismounted from Skaarl after you engage, attack enemies to build courage and aim to remount.
Yasuo.watch: Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has a narrow hitbox, so dodge to the side instead of retreating in a straight line. After it hits twice in a row, Yasuo Q Steel Tempest’s next cast becomes a tornado that knocks you up, so watch its sound and effects and be ready to dodge. If Yasuo E Sweeping Blade or Yasuo R Last Breath creates distance, the pull from Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope may disappear.

Aatrox.laning: Only push forward aggressively when Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope is ready. When it is down, use Kled E Jousting to keep the wave near your side. Avoid risky trades when Skaarl is low on health. If you win a trade, press your advantage by pressuring the turret.
Aatrox.build: Build armor first to withstand the physical damage from Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and W Infernal Chains.
Aatrox.combo: When Aatrox E Umbral Dash is down, close in with Kled E Jousting and land Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope. Stay close and weave in Kled W Violent Tendencies attacks; after the trap pulls Aatrox in, finish with the fourth hit. If Kled E Jousting hits initially, you can recast it to dash toward the same target.
Aatrox.escape: Right after you bait Aatrox E Umbral Dash is an opportunity to engage with Kled E Jousting or R Chaaaaaaaarge!!!. If Aatrox W Infernal Chains is still available, consider saving Kled E Jousting to escape its area.
Aatrox.fight: Trade right after Aatrox uses Aatrox P Deathbringer Stance’s empowered attack on a minion or uses Aatrox E Umbral Dash. After landing Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope, stay close to trigger the pull and land Kled W Violent Tendencies’ fourth hit.
Aatrox.phase: Kled has strong early trades, but Aatrox can also snowball quickly if he gets an early lead, so avoid giving up kills. Use Kled’s strong laning and midgame skirmishes to take turrets and objectives. Kled’s sustained damage falls off late, so turn your midgame lead into a game-ending push.
Aatrox.teamfight: Use Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! along a path your allies can follow, and remember that Kled charges the first enemy champion he encounters along the way. Even if Skaarl leaves after you engage, attack enemies to build courage and try to remount.
Aatrox.watch: Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade is dangerous when its edge hits, so watch its cast and move out of range or close in. If Aatrox W Infernal Chains hits you, leave its area immediately. When Aatrox R World Ender is active, stop dueling and reengage after it ends.

Darius.laning: When Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope is down, do not fight forward; use Kled E Jousting to pull the wave and keep it near your side. Poke right after Darius uses Darius Q Decimate to clear minions or misses Darius E Apprehend. If you win a trade, pressure the turret; do not overcommit when Skaarl is low or the enemy jungler is nearby.
Darius.teamfight: Use Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! along a path your allies can follow to engage together. Use the shield during the charge to withstand damage right after engaging, and choose your route knowing that Kled charges the first enemy champion along it. If Skaarl leaves, do not retreat immediately; attack enemies to build courage and try to remount. If Darius P Hemorrhage has stacked up and Darius R Noxian Guillotine could kill you, disengage completely.
Darius.build: Build armor first against Darius’s main damage, but also get health to account for the penetration on Darius E Apprehend and the true damage from Darius R Noxian Guillotine. Consider penetration because Kled’s physical damage is hindered by Darius’s high armor. If Darius Q Decimate’s healing keeps him alive even after Kled W Violent Tendencies’ fourth hit, build Executioner’s Calling earlier.
Darius.combo: When Darius E Apprehend is down, close in with Kled E Jousting and land Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope. Stay close and keep attacking with Kled W Violent Tendencies, then finish with the fourth hit after the trap pulls him in. Kled E Jousting’s recast only goes toward the target it first hit, so keep it in reserve with its direction in mind.
Darius.escape: Engage when Darius E Apprehend misses or is on cooldown. If Darius has also used Darius Q Decimate to clear minions, that is an opportunity to poke.
Darius.fight: Take short trades when Darius E Apprehend is down and Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope is ready. Close in with Kled E Jousting, stay close until the trap pulls, and land Kled W Violent Tendencies’ fourth hit. Cut off extended fights that build Darius P Hemorrhage stacks, then reengage after the stacks expire.
Darius.phase: Kled has strong early trades, but watch Skaarl’s health and beware of Darius’s early skirmishes and dives. Turn your lane lead into turret pressure and take objectives in midgame skirmishes. Kled’s sustained damage falls off after he dismounts late, so avoid letting the game go long.
Darius.watch: If Darius E Apprehend pulls you in, he can follow with basic attacks, Darius W Crippling Strike, and Darius Q Decimate, so wait outside its range. If Darius P Hemorrhage stacks build up, create distance. If you have stacks and are low enough to die to Darius R Noxian Guillotine, disengage completely.

Gangplank.laning: Avoid trading if there is a primed Gangplank E Powder Keg nearby or Skaarl is low on health. While Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope is unavailable, use Kled E Jousting to pull the wave and keep it on your side. After winning a fight, pressure the turret.
Gangplank.build: Build armor early in lane to withstand the physical damage from Gangplank Q Parrrley and E Powder Keg. If Gangplank W Remove Scurvy’s healing keeps him alive even after Kled W Violent Tendencies’ fourth hit, rush Executioner's Calling.
Gangplank.combo: Use Kled E Jousting to engage, land Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope, then stay close and get in Kled W Violent Tendencies’ fourth hit. When Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is down, look to trigger the trap’s pull. Keep in mind that recasting E moves you toward the target you first hit.
Gangplank.escape: Gangplank has no ability to create distance on his own, so close in with Kled E Jousting or R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! when nearby E Powder Kegs are not yet primed. If Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is also down, it’s a good window to catch him with Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope.
Gangplank.fight: If Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope is ready and Gangplank has just placed E Powder Keg, use Kled E Jousting to engage and trade. After landing the trap, stay close to trigger its pull. When Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is down, take advantage of the window to hold him.
Gangplank.phase: Use Kled’s strong early laning and midgame skirmishing to convert an advantage into turrets and objectives. His sustained damage drops off late game after he is dismounted, so play to avoid letting the game drag on.
Gangplank.teamfight: Use Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! along a path your allies can follow to start a team fight. Keep in mind that he charges the first enemy champion in his path. After engaging, keep attacking enemies to build Courage and look to remount, even if you are dismounted.
Gangplank.watch: Gangplank E Powder Keg becomes more dangerous as it ages, so avoid old kegs and spots where two kegs overlap. Gangplank W Remove Scurvy can remove Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope’s pull and restore health, so watch whether Gangplank uses W before fighting.

Mordekaiser.laning: Only step forward to trade when Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope is back. If it is unavailable, use Kled E Jousting to keep the wave on your side and basic attacks to prepare Kled W Violent Tendencies again. Don't take risks if Skaarl has little health, and turn winning trades into turret pressure.
Mordekaiser.teamfight: Use Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! along a path your allies can follow so they can engage with you. Keep your distance from allies so Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp can't pull several of you in at once, and avoid engaging in a way that leaves you isolated if Mordekaiser R Realm of Death is ready. Even if Skaarl leaves, try to build courage in the skirmish and remount rather than retreating immediately.
Mordekaiser.watch: If Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp pulls you in, it's easy to also get hit by Mordekaiser Q Obliterate and P Darkness Rise, so keep your distance in front of him. Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise activates after you are hit by three abilities or basic attacks, so take only one or two hits during a short trade before backing away. While Mordekaiser R Realm of Death is ready, don't enter its range alone and risk a duel without your allies' help.
Mordekaiser.build: Mordekaiser deals mostly magic damage and Kled has low magic resistance, so buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads. Fit Maw of Malmortius, which grants magic resistance and a shield, between your core items. If Mordekaiser W Indestructible's healing makes him hard to kill even with the fourth Kled W Violent Tendencies hit, buy Executioner's Calling earlier.
Mordekaiser.combo: After Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp is down, hit him with Kled E Jousting to close in and use Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope. Stay close and land Kled W Violent Tendencies attacks, then finish the fourth hit after the trap's pull. Kled E Jousting's recast only moves toward the target you first hit, so don't rely on it to escape; don't stay close for long after Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise activates.
Mordekaiser.escape: The moment Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp goes down is your chance to engage with Kled E Jousting. Mordekaiser has no skill to create distance on his own, so land Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope and stay close until it pulls him in. However, if Mordekaiser R Realm of Death is ready, don't enter its range alone.
Mordekaiser.fight: Back away from short trades before Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise activates. Look for a longer fight when Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp is down and you can land both Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope and Kled W Violent Tendencies' fourth hit. Don't unload your damage just after Mordekaiser W Indestructible grants its shield; focus him after the shield is worn down or converted into healing.
Mordekaiser.phase: Use Kled's strong early trades, but keep his low magic resistance and Skaarl's health in mind. Kled is strong in lane and in mid-game skirmishes, so turn your lead into turrets and objectives. In the late game, Skaarl leaves quickly after Kled engages and Kled deals less damage to champions while dismounted, so don't let the game drag on.

Shen.laning: Take control early by trading and pushing the wave, keeping Shen occupied with CS. When Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope is unavailable, pause the fights and use Kled E Jousting to pull the wave to your side. If Shen leaves lane with Shen R Stand United, pressure the turret in the empty lane.
Shen.build: Build tenacity first to deal with the taunt from Shen E Shadow Dash. Shen E Shadow Dash deals physical damage while Shen Q Twilight Assault deals magic damage, so don't focus on only one type of resistance. Given Shen Q Twilight Assault's damage based on your maximum health, avoid stacking health alone.
Shen.combo: After Shen E Shadow Dash is down, close in with Kled E Jousting, land Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope, and stay close until the pull triggers. Once Shen W Spirit's Refuge ends, get all four of Kled W Violent Tendencies' attacks in. Shen can interrupt the trap's pull by creating distance with Shen E Shadow Dash or Shen R Stand United.
Shen.escape: The opening to engage comes just after Shen E Shadow Dash misses. Look for a time when Shen can't use Shen R Stand United, then close the gap with Kled E Jousting or Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! and cast Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope.
Shen.fight: Start a fight when Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope is ready. If Shen E Shadow Dash misses, close in with Kled E Jousting and land the trap, then continue attacking after Shen W Spirit's Refuge ends. It's a good time to complete the trap's pull when Shen can no longer use Shen R Stand United.
Shen.phase: Pressure Shen's weak early laning to gain control and turret advantages. Kled is strong in midgame skirmishes, so turn your lead into turret and objective pressure. Late, Kled's sustained damage weakens after Skaarl leaves, so play to close out the game before it drags on.
Shen.teamfight: Use Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! along a path your allies can follow to engage together. The charge targets the first enemy champion along its path, so line up the route with your target. If you see Shen R Stand United's channel, alert your team. Even if Skaarl leaves during the skirmish, build Courage and look to remount.
Shen.watch: If taunted by Shen E Shadow Dash, you'll take empowered attacks from Shen Q Twilight Assault, so dodge the dash before retaliating. Also move out of the path of Shen Q Twilight Assault's returning blade. Shen W Spirit's Refuge blocks Kled W Violent Tendencies' attacks, so don't try to get the fourth hit in before the zone ends.

TahmKench.laning: Do not force trades while Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope is unavailable; use Kled E Jousting to pull the wave toward your side. If Tahm Kench has two stacks, back off and look for an opening again after they disappear. If you win the trade, carry that advantage into pressure on Turret Plating.
TahmKench.build: Early on, use a Null-Magic Mantle to withstand Tahm Kench’s magic damage and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Fit Maw of Malmortius into your core build to gain magic resistance and a shield. If the duel drags on because of healing from Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and Tahm Kench E Thick Skin, get Executioner’s Calling earlier; against his high armor, add armor penetration.
TahmKench.combo: Close in with Kled E Jousting and cast Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope on Tahm Kench. Follow up with Kled W Violent Tendencies attacks and stay close until the trap’s pull triggers, then finish the fourth hit. When recasting Kled E Jousting, account for it returning toward the Tahm Kench it first hit.
TahmKench.escape: Your opening to engage is when Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive is down and Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste has no stacks. Go in with Kled E Jousting and land Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope to make it hard for Tahm Kench to create distance. Back off if he has two stacks or you need to dodge the area knock-up from Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive.
TahmKench.fight: Trade when Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope is ready and Skaarl has enough health. If Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive is down, close in with Kled E Jousting and stay close until the trap pulls. Tahm Kench E Thick Skin turns damage into a shield or healing, so fight when you can land Kled W Violent Tendencies’ fourth hit rather than trading small hits and backing off.
TahmKench.phase: Kled is strong in the early laning phase and midgame skirmishes, so turn your advantage in trades into kills, Turret Plating, and objectives. In late-game team fights, sustained damage weakens after you engage and are dismounted from Skaarl, so focus on securing your lead in the midgame.
TahmKench.teamfight: Use Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! along a path your allies can follow so you can engage together. If an ally has been devoured, focus your damage on the heavily slowed Tahm Kench. Even if you are dismounted from Skaarl, attack an enemy to build courage and aim to remount.
TahmKench.watch: If Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste is stacked, taking another basic attack or Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash can open you up to a stun and Tahm Kench R Devour. When you have two stacks, create distance and wait for them to disappear. If you see the animation for Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive, dodge the area knock-up at its landing point.

Udyr.laning: Udyr appears from the jungle to gank, so keep vision on key routes and jungle entrances, and don’t move forward when he’s out of sight. Don’t start a fight without Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope; use Kled E Jousting to keep the wave on your side. If you win a trade, carry that advantage into turret pressure.
Udyr.build: Build armor first to defend against Udyr’s physical damage. If the magic damage from Udyr R Wingborne Storm dismounts you from Skaarl quickly, fit Maw of Malmortius between your core items. If Udyr W Iron Mantle’s healing makes him hard to finish even with Kled W Violent Tendencies’ damage, get Executioner’s Calling earlier.
Udyr.combo: After Udyr E Blazing Stampede is down, close in with Kled E Jousting and hit Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope. Keep attacking with Kled W Violent Tendencies, trigger the trap’s pull, and finish the fourth hit. Remember that Kled E Jousting’s recast only targets the first enemy it hit.
Udyr.escape: The opportunity to go in with Kled E Jousting comes after you’ve taken one stun from Udyr E Blazing Stampede or just made him use it. After the Awakening of Udyr E Blazing Stampede ends, land Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope to block his escape. Conversely, while Udyr E Blazing Stampede is ready, don’t try to create distance by walking; save Kled E Jousting or Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope.
Udyr.fight: Bait out Udyr E Blazing Stampede, then close the gap with Kled E Jousting and hit Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope. Stay close while the trap is attached to trigger its pull and land Kled W Violent Tendencies’ fourth attack. Once Udyr W Iron Mantle’s shield expires, keep pressuring him without giving him time to heal.
Udyr.phase: Kled is strong in lane and in mid-game skirmishes, so turn an early lead into turret pressure and look for objectives in mid game. In late-game teamfights, your sustained damage drops after you are dismounted from Skaarl, so play to avoid dragging the game out.
Udyr.teamfight: Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! charges at the first enemy champion in its path, so avoid a path that makes you hit the durable Udyr first, and engage where your team can follow. Take down the weaker enemies behind Udyr before targeting Udyr, who has defensive items and the shield from Udyr W Iron Mantle. Even if you are dismounted from Skaarl after you engage, attack to build courage and aim to remount.
Udyr.watch: Udyr E Blazing Stampede dashes in, stuns, and can also break the tether from Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope, so don’t rush to land the trap right after Udyr uses it. Udyr is immune to immobilizing effects while Udyr E Blazing Stampede is Awakened, so catch him with Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope after the Awakening ends. Udyr Q Wilding Claw and Udyr R Wingborne Storm deal damage based on maximum health, so avoid fighting when Skaarl is low on health.

Yone.teamfight: Use Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! along a path your team can follow, keeping in mind that it charges at the first enemy champion in its path. Spread out from your allies so Yone W Spirit Cleave’s shield doesn’t grow as much, and don’t stand alone at the very back in the path of Yone R Fate Sealed. Even if you lose Skaarl after you engage, attack nearby enemies to build courage and aim to remount.
Yone.build: First, get enough movement speed to leave the announced attack areas. Yone deals both physical and magic damage, so build both armor and magic resistance. Yone W Spirit Cleave deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid choices that add a large amount of health alone, and consider attack speed reduction effects.
Yone.combo: After Yone’s mobility options are down, approach with Kled E Jousting and hit Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope. Stay close while the trap is attached and land basic attacks with Kled W Violent Tendencies; when the pull triggers, finish the fourth hit. Kled E Jousting’s recast only moves toward the first target it hit, so check the direction of movement before using it.
Yone.escape: Check that Yone Q Mortal Steel’s tornado and Yone E Soul Unbound are down before engaging. If Yone R Fate Sealed is still on cooldown, this is a chance to close the gap with Kled E Jousting or R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! and hit Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope. If Yone still has a mobility option, he can get out of the trap’s range.
Yone.fight: Start a trade when Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope is ready and Yone’s mobility ability is down. Close in with Kled E Jousting, land the trap, then stay close to trigger the pull and land Kled W Violent Tendencies’ fourth hit. If Yone uses a mobility ability to get out of the trap’s range, the pull will disappear, so check his remaining mobility before going in.
Yone.laning: Back off when Yone Q Mortal Steel’s tornado is ready, and avoid forced trades while Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope is unavailable. If you win a trade, extend your advantage with turret pressure.
Yone.phase: Kled is strong in lane and in mid-game skirmishes, so turn your advantage into turret pressure and objectives. In late game, Kled’s sustained damage drops, so play to avoid dragging the game out.
Yone.watch: If Yone repeatedly uses Yone Q Mortal Steel on minions, his tornado engage is ready, so keep your distance until the stacks disappear. If he dives in with Yone E Soul Unbound, he may deal extra damage when he returns, so if you’re low on health, get out of range before he returns. Yone R Fate Sealed pulls in enemies along its path, so don’t stand alone at the very back of your formation just before a teamfight.

Garen.teamfight: Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! charges the first enemy champion in its path, so choose your target and a path your allies can follow. Use the shield gained while charging to absorb damage right after engaging, but do not apply all of Kled’s crowd control at once just after Garen W Courage. Even if you are dismounted, build Courage in the skirmish by attacking enemies and look to remount, but stay out of Garen R Demacian Justice’s range when your health is low enough to be executed.
Garen.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Garen Q Decisive Strike and E Judgment. Garen R Demacian Justice cannot be reduced by resistances, so consider your total health as well. If Garen P Perseverance’s healing keeps him alive even after Kled W Violent Tendencies’ fourth hit, rush Executioner's Calling.
Garen.combo: After Garen Q Decisive Strike is down, hit him with Kled E Jousting to close in and land Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope. Keep attacking with Kled W Violent Tendencies and stay close to trigger the trap’s pull, then finish the fourth hit. If Garen activates W Courage, delay using Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope and E Jousting by half a beat.
Garen.escape: Garen has no mobility ability to create distance, so go in with Kled E Jousting when Garen Q Decisive Strike’s silence is down. Landing Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope makes it hard for him to escape, but if Garen E Judgment starts, trade briefly and move out of its spinning range.
Garen.fight: Start a trade when Garen Q Decisive Strike has been used on a minion or its empowered attack has been consumed, and Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope is ready. Engage with Kled E Jousting and land the trap, staying close until its pull triggers, but do not prolong the fight inside Garen E Judgment. If Garen W Courage is visible, delay your damage and trap by half a beat.
Garen.laning: Pressure Garen early so he has no room to build stacks on Garen W Courage. Do not fight if Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope is unavailable or Skaarl is low on health. After winning a trade, push the wave to pressure Turret Plating, then create a numbers advantage elsewhere after pushing in the wave.
Garen.phase: Pressure Garen early with Kled’s strong trades and limit his room to scale. Convert Kled’s advantage in lane and midgame skirmishes into turrets and objectives. You fall behind as Garen W Courage gains permanent stacks over time, while Kled’s sustained damage also weakens late game, so do not let the game drag on.
Garen.watch: Garen Q Decisive Strike empowers his next attack and silences, preventing you from retaliating, so do not engage while he has it ready. Move out of range when Garen E Judgment starts spinning, and do not commit Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope and E Jousting right after Garen W Courage. If you are below half health, beware Garen R Demacian Justice, which deals true damage based on your missing health, and stay out of its range.

Jax.laning: Jax has the advantage in melee fights at level 1, so do not force an engage. From level 2 onward, trade when Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope is available to build a CS and level lead. When Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope is unavailable, use Kled E Jousting to keep the wave on your side. Extend a won fight by pressuring the turret.
Jax.teamfight: If Jax dives in with E Counter Strike active, do not group around him; wait for the area stun to end, then focus your crowd control. Use Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! along a path your allies can follow. Even if you are dismounted after engaging, keep attacking and look to remount.
Jax.build: Jax relies on basic attacks and attack speed for damage, so prioritize items that reduce his attack speed. Jax Q Leap Strike deals physical damage, while Jax W Empower and E Counter Strike deal magic damage, so build both armor and magic resistance. Jax E Counter Strike deals damage based on your max health, so avoid stacking health alone.
Jax.combo: After Jax E Counter Strike ends and Jax Q Leap Strike is down, engage with Kled E Jousting and land Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope. Stay close and keep attacking with Kled W Violent Tendencies, then finish the fourth hit after the trap’s pull.
Jax.escape: Engage after both Jax Q Leap Strike and Jax E Counter Strike are down. If he approaches with Jax E Counter Strike active, stop basic attacking and use the Kled E Jousting you held to move out of its stun range.
Jax.fight: The opportunity to engage is after Jax E Counter Strike ends and Jax Q Leap Strike is down. Land Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope, then stay close to trigger its pull and get in Kled W Violent Tendencies’ fourth hit.
Jax.phase: Kled’s sustained damage drops off late game, so bring the game to a close earlier with turrets and objectives during midgame.
Jax.watch: While Jax E Counter Strike is active, basic attacks are negated, and its recast damage increases with each attack dodged, so stop basic attacking.

Kennen.laning: Block Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken from behind minions, and step forward only briefly to last-hit. When Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope is unavailable, use Kled E Jousting to pull the wave and keep the lane on your side. Pressure the turret if you win the trade.
Kennen.watch: Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken only hits the first target, so stand behind minions. If two stacks of Kennen P Mark of the Storm build up, move out of range to avoid the third mark and stun. Don't stand on top of allies when Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom engages.
Kennen.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle early and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Prioritize magic resistance because Kennen deals mostly magic damage and Kled has low magic resistance, and fit Maw of Malmortius between your core items.
Kennen.combo: After Kennen E Lightning Rush is down, close in with Kled E Jousting and land Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope. Stay close and land Kled W Violent Tendencies attacks, then finish with the fourth hit after the trap's pull triggers.
Kennen.escape: Look to engage after Kennen E Lightning Rush is down and Kennen P Mark of the Storm stacks have expired. Close the gap with Kled E Jousting or Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!!, then catch him with Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope.
Kennen.fight: Fight when Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope is ready. Make Kennen use E Lightning Rush, then close in with Kled E Jousting and land the trap. Stay close until its pull triggers. If two stacks of Kennen P Mark of the Storm build up, back away first and wait for them to expire.
Kennen.phase: Kled is strong in early trades, but avoid fighting when Skaarl has little health. Kled is strong in lane and in mid-game skirmishes, so turn your lead into turrets and objectives. In late-game teamfights, Kled's sustained damage weakens after Skaarl leaves, so aim to avoid letting the game drag on.
Kennen.teamfight: Spread out from your allies to anticipate Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom's engage angle. Use Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! along a path your allies can follow, keeping in mind that it charges at the first enemy champion it encounters. After engaging, even if Skaarl leaves, attack enemies to build courage and try to remount.

Ornn.laning: Trade when Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope is ready. When it isn't, use Kled E Jousting to keep the wave on your side. If Ornn tries to craft an item in lane, get on him and attack to interrupt the craft. Pressure the turret after winning a fight.
Ornn.phase: Ornn's damage is low early, so Kled should establish a lane advantage. Kled is strong in lane and in midgame skirmishes, so pressure turrets and objectives. In the late game, Kled's sustained damage weakens while Ornn gains items and his allies gain Masterwork upgrades, so play to close out the game before it drags on.
Ornn.combo: After Ornn's mobility is down, close in with Kled E Jousting and land Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope. Stay close and get in Kled W Violent Tendencies' attacks; when the trap's pull triggers, finish with the fourth attack. Kled E Jousting's recast only goes toward the first target it hit, so keep that in mind when using it.
Ornn.escape: Don't rush in when only Ornn E Searing Charge is down, since Ornn can escape with Ornn R Call of the Forge God. Close the gap with Kled E Jousting or Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! before Ornn R Call of the Forge God comes back up, especially while Ornn E Searing Charge is also down. If Ornn W Bellows Breath makes you brittle, keep your distance first and go in after the effect ends.
Ornn.fight: Look to fight before Ornn R Call of the Forge God comes back up. If Ornn E Searing Charge is also down, close in with Kled E Jousting, land Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope, and stay close until the pull triggers. Trade when you can get in Kled W Violent Tendencies' fourth attack.
Ornn.teamfight: Use Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! along a path your allies can follow, and account for the charge targeting the first enemy champion along its path. Avoid the straight line between Ornn R Call of the Forge God's spirit and Ornn, and avoid its return path as well. Even if Skaarl leaves after you engage, attack enemies in the skirmish to build Courage and remount.
Ornn.watch: Stand away from the pillar created by Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture and from walls. Ornn E Searing Charge knocks you up if it hits a pillar or wall, so move toward open space when he lines up the charge. If the final burst of Ornn W Bellows Breath makes you brittle, don't move in; keep your distance until the effect ends.

Renekton.laning: Keep your distance while Renekton’s Fury is full, and move in when he has none or has spent his abilities. While Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope is unavailable, use Kled E Jousting to keep the wave on your side. Avoid trading if Skaarl is very low on health, and turn won fights into turret pressure.
Renekton.teamfight: Use Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! along a path your allies can follow to engage together. It charges at the first enemy champion along its path, so choose your route with your target in mind. Even if Skaarl leaves after you engage, don't retreat immediately; attack enemies to build Courage and look to remount.
Renekton.build: If Renekton's healing from Renekton Q Cull the Meek means Kled W Violent Tendencies' fourth attack won't finish him, buy Executioner's Calling earlier. Build armor first to counter Renekton's main damage, but keep the magic damage from Renekton R Dominus and the armor reduction from empowered Renekton E Slice and Dice in mind.
Renekton.combo: After Renekton E Slice and Dice is down, close in with Kled E Jousting and land Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope. Stay close to get all four of Kled W Violent Tendencies' attacks in, keeping near him so the pull triggers. Kled E Jousting's recast only goes toward the first target it hit, so check that direction before using it.
Renekton.escape: The window to go in with Kled E Jousting or Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! opens as soon as Renekton E Slice and Dice is down. If Renekton W Ruthless Predator's stun is also down, catch him with Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope and retaliate.
Renekton.fight: Trade when Renekton has no Fury and Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope is ready. If Renekton E Slice and Dice is down, close in with Kled E Jousting and stay close until Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope's pull triggers.
