Also retaliate immediately after Renekton has used Renekton Q Cull the Meek, Renekton W Ruthless Predator, and Renekton E Slice and Dice.
Renekton.phase: Wait out the duration of Renekton R Dominus, and turn your midgame advantage into turret and objective pressure. Kled's sustained damage weakens late, so play to close out the game before it drags on.
Renekton.watch: When Renekton P Reign of Anger is near or above half full, watch out for the empowered stun from Renekton W Ruthless Predator and stay out of its range. Renekton E Slice and Dice can use minions to get in, so don't stand in or behind a group of minions.

Singed.laning: Avoid fighting when Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope is unavailable, and use Kled E Jousting to keep the wave on your side. If you win the trade, keep your advantage by pressuring the turret.
Singed.build: Singed’s main damage is magic, and Kled has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury’s Treads, then fit Maw of Malmortius between your core items to survive just after being dismounted from Skaarl.
Singed.combo: Avoid the area covered by Singed W Mega Adhesive, then close in with Kled E Jousting and land Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope. Stay close and attack with Kled W Violent Tendencies; when the trap’s pull triggers, finish with the fourth attack. Use Kled E Jousting’s recast knowing it will head toward the target it first hit.
Singed.escape: Singed has no ability to create distance on his own, so engage with Kled E Jousting when Singed W Mega Adhesive has not been laid down and you have dodged Singed E Fling. If you are standing on the adhesive, you cannot dash out, so walk off it first.
Singed.fight: After dodging Singed W Mega Adhesive, trade with Kled E Jousting when Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope is ready. After landing the trap, stay close until the pull triggers and get in Kled W Violent Tendencies’ fourth attack. If Singed runs away while leaving poison behind, stop chasing unless you have enough damage to finish him reliably.
Singed.phase: Turn the advantage you gain from Kled’s strong laning and midgame skirmishes into turrets and objectives. In late-game team fights, your sustained damage falls off after you are dismounted from Skaarl, so avoid letting the game drag on.
Singed.teamfight: Use Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! along a path your allies can follow so you can engage together. Instead of chasing Singed to the end, lock him down with Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope or a similar ability and attack Singed’s allies. Even if you dismount from Skaarl after engaging, attack a nearby enemy to build courage and aim to remount.
Singed.watch: Do not chase a low-health Singed through Singed Q Poison Trail. You cannot dash while standing on Singed W Mega Adhesive, so go around it. If Singed E Fling hits you while you are on the adhesive, it can lead into a root, so check whether there are enemies behind Singed and keep your distance.

Teemo.laning: Avoid trades where Teemo E Toxic Shot hits you once at a time before you back off; wait out of range until you are ready to engage. When Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope is unavailable, use Kled E Jousting to pull the wave toward your side. Avoid fighting if Skaarl is low on health, and pressure Turret Plating if you win the fight.
Teemo.build: Early on, hold out with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Teemo’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first, and fit Maw of Malmortius between your core items.
Teemo.combo: When Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down, close in with Kled E Jousting and land Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope. Stay close and attack with Kled W Violent Tendencies; when the trap’s pull triggers, finish the fourth hit. While blinded, deal damage with abilities instead of basic attacks, or back off.
Teemo.escape: Teemo has no separate mobility ability and uses Teemo W Move Quick to gain movement speed, so engage during the window when Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down. Close the distance with Kled E Jousting or Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!!, then catch him with Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope.
Teemo.fight: Trade when Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope is ready, right after Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down. Close in with Kled E Jousting and land the trap, then stay close until the pull triggers and get in Kled W Violent Tendencies’ fourth hit. Stay on Teemo so he cannot escape with Teemo W Move Quick and break the trap.
Teemo.phase: Kled has strong attack damage early, but avoid trading when Skaarl is low on health. Turn your advantage from laning and midgame skirmishes into turrets and objectives, and limit the time Teemo has to plant mushrooms. In the late game, you can be dismounted from Skaarl quickly after Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! engages, so play to avoid letting the game drag on.
Teemo.teamfight: Use Oracle Lens to clear Teemo R Noxious Trap near objectives and in narrow passages. Engage with Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! along a path your allies can follow, and use the shield you gain during the charge to absorb damage right after engaging. Even if you are dismounted from Skaarl, attack nearby enemies to build courage and aim to remount.
Teemo.watch: Teemo Q Blinding Dart negates basic attacks, so if it hits you, do not try to land Kled W Violent Tendencies’ fourth hit; use abilities or back off instead. Even one basic attack from Teemo E Toxic Shot applies ongoing poison damage, so stay out of range unless you are ready to engage. Watch for Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare’s stealth and Teemo R Noxious Trap in bushes without vision and paths near objectives.

Urgot.laning: Only look to trade when Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope is back. If Urgot E Disdain is ready, he can get out of the trap’s range, so make him use it before fighting. While Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope is unavailable, use Kled E Jousting to keep the wave on your side, and pressure the turret if you win the fight.
Urgot.teamfight: Use Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! along a path your allies can follow. Skaarl charges at the first enemy champion it encounters, so do not plan on passing Urgot to reach the backline. Urgot E Disdain stops at the first champion it hits, so engage with the frontline; even if you are dismounted, attack enemies to build courage and aim to remount.
Urgot.build: Urgot’s main damage is physical, so buy an armor item first and build armor. Urgot P Echoing Flames deals percent-max-health damage, so avoid choosing items that add a lot of health alone. For damage, add armor penetration against Urgot’s high armor.
Urgot.combo: When Urgot E Disdain is down, close in with Kled E Jousting and land Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope. Follow up with Kled W Violent Tendencies attacks to trigger the trap’s pull and finish the fourth hit. If your first Kled E Jousting hits Urgot, you can use its recast to create distance.
Urgot.escape: Urgot E Disdain is his only mobility ability, so engage right after it is down. If Urgot Q Corrosive Charge also misses, close the distance with Kled E Jousting while avoiding the heavy slow, then catch him with Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope.
Urgot.fight: Right after Urgot E Disdain is down, you have a chance to close in with Kled E Jousting. Land Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope then and stay close until the pull triggers. After getting in Kled W Violent Tendencies’ fourth hit, create distance so you are not exposed to the leg cannons for long.
Urgot.phase: Kled has strong trades early, but prolonged face-to-face fights with Urgot let his leg cannon damage add up, so pick short windows to fight. Laning and midgame skirmishes are Kled’s strong phases, so turn your advantage into turrets and objectives. In the late game, sustained damage weakens after you are dismounted from Skaarl, so play to avoid letting the game drag on.
Urgot.watch: Each leg of Urgot P Echoing Flames deals percent-max-health damage, so do not stay beside him for long. If Urgot Q Corrosive Charge hits you, Urgot W Purge focuses its fire on you while you are heavily slowed, so decide immediately whether to dodge with Kled E Jousting as it comes in. If Urgot R Fear Beyond Death hits you, get out of its range before reaching the execution threshold.

Yorick.laning: Don’t fight where many graves have accumulated, and push so minions die under Yorick’s turret instead of letting him clear the wave on his side. Play forward when Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope is ready, and avoid trades when it isn’t. If you win a trade, follow up with turret pressure.
Yorick.build: Build armor first against Yorick Q Last Rites and the physical damage from his Mist Walkers. Yorick E Mourning Mist and Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles deal magic damage based on maximum health, so be careful about choices that add a large amount of health alone. If Yorick’s healing from Q Last Rites means you can’t kill him even with Kled W Violent Tendencies’ fourth hit, get Executioner’s Calling earlier.
Yorick.combo: Close in with Kled E Jousting and hit Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope. Stay close and land basic attacks with Kled W Violent Tendencies; when the trap’s pull triggers, finish the fourth hit. Remember that Kled E Jousting’s recast targets the first unit it hit.
Yorick.escape: Go in with Kled E Jousting when Yorick E Mourning Mist misses and Yorick W Dark Procession is down. Yorick has no mobility, so it’s easy to keep close after catching him with Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope. If you’re trapped by Yorick W Dark Procession, hit the wall or cross it with Kled E Jousting.
Yorick.fight: The chance to engage comes after Yorick E Mourning Mist misses and Yorick W Dark Procession has been used. Yorick has no mobility, so close in with Kled E Jousting, hit Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope, and stay close until the pull triggers. Start a trade when you can land Kled W Violent Tendencies’ fourth hit.
Yorick.phase: Kled is strong in lane and in mid-game skirmishes, so turn your advantage during this time into turret pressure and objectives. If Yorick pushes a side lane, catch the wave, then look to join your team with the long-distance charge from Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!!. In late game, Kled’s sustained damage can drop after engaging and dismounting from Skaarl, so play to avoid dragging the game out.
Yorick.teamfight: Use Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! along a path your team can follow, keeping in mind that it charges at the first enemy champion in its path. Even if you are dismounted from Skaarl after you engage, attack enemy champions to build courage and aim to remount. If you can clear Yorick’s Mist Walkers first, you can reduce the damage Yorick deals.
Yorick.watch: Yorick E Mourning Mist slows, marks, and deals damage based on maximum health, so dodge the orb’s trajectory. Avoid fighting when many graves have accumulated or the Maiden of the Mist is beside Yorick. If you’re trapped by Yorick W Dark Procession, hit the wall to break it or cross it with Kled E Jousting.

DrMundo.laning: Dodge Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw by keeping a minion between you and him. After trading, step on the canister Dr. Mundo drops as you retreat to deny its healing and passive cooldown reduction. When Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope is down, do not force a trade; keep the wave near your side, and pressure the turret if you win a trade.
DrMundo.teamfight: Start teamfights with Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! along a path your allies can follow. Choose your route knowing that Kled charges the first enemy champion in its path, and use the shield to absorb attacks right after engaging. Even if Skaarl leaves, do not retreat immediately; attack enemies to build courage and try to remount.
DrMundo.build: Dr. Mundo’s main damage from E Blunt Force Trauma is physical, so build armor first. If a long fight makes the healing from Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases, Q Infected Bonesaw, and W Heart Zapper a problem, build Executioner’s Calling earlier and maintain Grievous Wounds with basic attacks.
DrMundo.combo: Use Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope to draw out Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases first. Then close in by hitting Dr. Mundo with Kled E Jousting, and keep attacking with Kled W Violent Tendencies until you land the fourth hit. Kled E Jousting’s recast heads toward the target it first hit, so check Dr. Mundo’s position when you use it.
DrMundo.escape: Engage after Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is down. When you block Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw with a minion or dodge it, also look for a chance to close in with Kled E Jousting and catch him with Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope. Look to dive or force an objective while Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is down.
DrMundo.fight: Fight when Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope is ready. First draw out Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases, then close in while he has no ability to create distance and stay close until the trap pulls him. Choose fights where you can land Kled W Violent Tendencies’ fourth hit.
DrMundo.phase: Kled has strong early-lane trades and peaks through midgame skirmishes. Convert wins during this period into turret and objective advantages. In late-game teamfights, his sustained damage falls off after Skaarl leaves, so do not let the game go long.
DrMundo.watch: Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw hits the first target in its path and deals damage based on current health, so be especially careful at high health and stand behind minions. Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases ignores the first immobilizing effect, so do not use Kled’s key engage ability while the passive is available. Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage grants healing and movement speed while active, so do not spend time trying to kill him during it.

Gnar.laning: Trade with Mini Gnar when Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope is ready. Avoid fighting and keep the wave on your side if the trap is unavailable or Skaarl is low on health. After winning a trade, extend your advantage by pressuring the turret.
Gnar.teamfight: Right after Gnar changes from Mega to Mini, use the window when he cannot transform again to start a team fight with Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! Charge along a path your allies can follow, keeping in mind that you charge the first enemy champion in your path. Avoid walls and narrow terrain. Even if you are dismounted, keep attacking enemies to build Courage and look to remount.
Gnar.build: Build armor first against Gnar’s main damage from Q Boomerang Throw / Boulder Toss, E Hop / Crunch, and R GNAR! Gnar W Hyper / Wallop deals magic damage based on your max health, so be cautious about stacking health alone. If it is hard to avoid Gnar R GNAR! near a wall, prioritize tenacity.
Gnar.combo: When Gnar E Hop / Crunch is down, engage with Kled E Jousting and land Q Bear Trap on a Rope. Stay close and keep attacking with W Violent Tendencies, then finish the fourth hit after the trap’s pull triggers. Recasting Kled E Jousting sends you toward the target you first hit, so check your direction before using it.
Gnar.escape: The window to engage is right after you make Gnar use E Hop / Crunch. Close the gap with Kled E Jousting or R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! and land Q Bear Trap on a Rope to make it hard for Gnar to escape. While Mega Gnar has R GNAR! ready, avoid angles that could push you toward a wall.
Gnar.fight: Right after Mini Gnar uses E Hop / Crunch, engage with Kled E Jousting and land Q Bear Trap on a Rope. Stay close while the trap is active to trigger its pull, then get in W Violent Tendencies’ fourth hit. Create distance right after Gnar transforms into Mega Gnar to wait out his power spike.
Gnar.phase: Use Kled’s strong early trades, but watch your health so Mini Gnar’s poke does not dismount you. Midgame is a good time for Kled to snowball an advantage, so convert kills and turret pressure into objectives. His sustained damage drops off late game, so play to avoid letting the game drag on.
Gnar.watch: Gnar Q Boomerang Throw / Boulder Toss slows, and Mini Gnar’s boomerang can hit you again on its return. Move out of its path so Gnar cannot catch it. Avoid fighting Mega Gnar head-on as he closes in, and when near walls, position yourself so Gnar R GNAR! does not knock you into a stun.

Sion.laning: Trade when Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope is back, and when it is unavailable, use Kled E Jousting to pull the wave toward your side. If Skaarl is low on health, do not force a trade. If you win the trade, pressure the turret, and do not let Sion keep killing minions to stack maximum health.
Sion.teamfight: Use Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! along a path your allies can follow so you can engage together. Skaarl charges at the first enemy champion in its path, so do not choose a route that passes Sion to reach the backline. Even if you dismount after engaging, keep attacking to build courage and aim to remount instead of retreating right away. But if Sion P Glory in Death activates, reposition rather than continuing to fight there.
Sion.build: Build armor first against Sion’s main damage from Sion P Glory in Death, Sion Q Decimating Smash, and Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught. Sion E Roar of the Slayer reduces your armor, so even after building resistances, it is important to avoid getting hit. Sion P Glory in Death deals percent-max-health damage, so be careful about choosing items that add a lot of health alone.
Sion.combo: After dodging Sion Q Decimating Smash sideways or while Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught is down, close in with Kled E Jousting. Land Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope, follow up with Kled W Violent Tendencies attacks, and stay close. When the pull triggers, finish the fourth attack, and use Kled E Jousting’s recast knowing it only goes toward the target it first hit.
Sion.escape: The window to engage is when Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught is down. Make Sion use Sion Q Decimating Smash early or dodge it sideways, then close the distance with Kled E Jousting and catch him with Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope.
Sion.fight: Keep your distance while the trap is attached to trigger the pull, and get in Kled W Violent Tendencies’ fourth attack. When Sion W Soul Furnace activates, focus your damage on the shield and use the chance to break it before it explodes.
Sion.phase: Early on, make use of Kled’s strong trades, but keep an eye on Skaarl’s health. In the midgame, turn your laning advantage into turrets and objectives. As the game goes on, Sion stacks maximum health by killing minions, while Kled’s sustained damage in late-game team fights weakens, so avoid letting the game drag on.
Sion.watch: Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught charges in a straight line, so dodge sideways instead of running forward or backward. After Sion falls, reposition to avoid the fast attacks and percent-max-health damage from Sion P Glory in Death.

Trundle.laning: Trundle P King’s Tribute heals him when nearby units die, so after lowering his health, claim your advantage right away or push the wave to force him to recall. When Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope is unavailable, do not trade; use Kled E Jousting to keep the wave on your side. Do not force a fight if Skaarl is low on health, and pressure the turret after winning a trade.
Trundle.teamfight: Use Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! along a path your allies can follow to start the team fight. While Trundle R Subjugate is active, do not fight Trundle alone; target someone else or create distance. Even if you are dismounted after you engage, attack to build courage and aim to remount.
Trundle.build: Build armor first against Trundle Q Chomp and his basic attacks. If healing from Trundle P King’s Tribute means even Kled W Violent Tendencies’ fourth hit cannot finish him, get Executioner’s Calling earlier. Trundle R Subjugate steals your resistances and deals percent-max-health damage, so creating distance while it is active matters more than stacking only resistances or health.
Trundle.combo: In open terrain with Trundle E Pillar of Ice down, close in with Kled E Jousting and land Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope. Follow up with Kled W Violent Tendencies attacks and stay close until the trap’s pull triggers, then finish the fourth hit. When recasting Kled E Jousting, account for it moving toward the target it first hit.
Trundle.escape: After Trundle E Pillar of Ice is down, you have an opening to engage with Kled E Jousting. If Trundle W Frozen Domain is active, back out of it first, then re-engage after the attack damage reduction from Trundle Q Chomp ends. Trundle has no ability to create distance on his own, so landing Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope then makes it easy to stay close.
Trundle.fight: When Trundle E Pillar of Ice is down and the fight is outside Trundle W Frozen Domain, engage while landing Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope. If you were hit by Trundle Q Chomp, fight again after its attack damage reduction ends. After landing the trap, stay close with Kled E Jousting to trigger the pull and get in Kled W Violent Tendencies’ fourth hit.
Trundle.phase: Both champions are strong early, so only choose a fight when Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope is available. Kled should turn his laning advantage into midgame turrets and objectives, and play to avoid letting the game drag on until his sustained damage weakens.
Trundle.watch: Trundle Q Chomp reduces your attack damage, so avoid trading until the effect ends. Trundle W Frozen Domain strengthens his attack speed and healing, so back out of it. Trundle E Pillar of Ice blocks your escape in narrow paths, so fight in open terrain and move sideways as soon as the pillar appears. While Trundle R Subjugate is active, he steals your resistances and becomes tankier, so create distance.

Jayce.laning: While Jayce is strong early, watch whether he has his cannon and farm by moving side to side to dodge Jayce Q Shock Blast. Avoid trading when Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope is unavailable, and use Kled E Jousting to keep the wave on your side. If you win a trade, pressure the turret. If you have lost health, do not overstay; clear the wave and then return.
Jayce.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first early on and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Prioritize magic resistance against Jayce W Lightning Field and E Thundering Blow, but dodge the physical damage from Jayce Q Shock Blast by moving sideways.
Jayce.combo: When Jayce Q To the Skies! is down, engage with Kled E Jousting and land Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope. Follow with Kled W Violent Tendencies and stay close while attacking. When the trap’s pull triggers, finish the fourth hit. If Jayce creates distance, you can follow with Kled E Jousting’s recast, which sends you toward the target you first hit.
Jayce.escape: The window to engage Jayce is right after Jayce Q To the Skies! is down. If Jayce E Thundering Blow’s knockback is also down, engage with Kled E Jousting and catch him with Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope.
Jayce.fight: Right after Jayce Q To the Skies! is down, engage with Kled E Jousting and land Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope. Stay close while the trap is active and get in Kled W Violent Tendencies’ fourth hit. Do not start a trade if Skaarl is low on health.
Jayce.phase: Jayce is strongest early, so if you fall behind, farm defensively instead of trying to force a comeback. Kled is strong in lane and in midgame skirmishes, so convert any advantage into turrets and objectives. His sustained damage drops off late game, so play to finish the game during midgame.
Jayce.teamfight: Look for the moment Jayce Q To the Skies! is down and engage with Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! along a path your allies can follow. Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! charges the first enemy champion in its path, so account for the route if another enemy is between you and Jayce. Even if you are dismounted after engaging, keep attacking enemies to build Courage and look to remount.
Jayce.watch: When you see Jayce E Acceleration Gate, Jayce Q Shock Blast may follow, so move sideways out of its line. Jayce with his hammer can jump in with Jayce Q To the Skies! and knock you back with Jayce E Thundering Blow, so check whether he has used both abilities before closing in.

Pantheon.laning: When Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope is unavailable, avoid trading and use Kled E Jousting to keep the wave on your side. Don't start a fight if Skaarl is low on health. Pressure the turret after winning a trade.
Pantheon.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Pantheon Q Comet Spear, Pantheon W Shield Vault, and Pantheon E Aegis Assault. Pantheon W Shield Vault deals damage based on your maximum health, so be careful about investing heavily in health alone. Pantheon has fairly high armor, so consider penetration or damage that is less affected by armor.
Pantheon.combo: After Pantheon W Shield Vault is down, close in with Kled E Jousting and land Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope. Keep attacking with Kled W Violent Tendencies and stay close until the trap's pull triggers; get in the fourth hit. If Kled E Jousting initially hit Pantheon, you can recast it to close in on him again.
Pantheon.escape: Look to engage after Pantheon W Shield Vault is down and before Pantheon R Grand Starfall comes back up. If only one of his mobility tools is down, he can use the other to get out of Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope's range, so don't rush in.
Pantheon.fight: Look for an opening after Pantheon W Shield Vault is down and before Pantheon R Grand Starfall comes back up. When Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope is ready, close in with Kled E Jousting, land the trap, and stay close until the pull triggers. If Pantheon E Aegis Assault is blocking from the front, wait for it to end or attack from the side.
Pantheon.phase: Kled is strong in lane and in midgame skirmishes, so convert your advantage into turret and objective pressure. Pantheon's influence also falls off late, but Kled's sustained teamfight damage weakens too, so aim to secure the game in the midgame.
Pantheon.teamfight: Use Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! along a path your allies can follow to engage together, and use its charge shield to absorb damage just after going in. It charges at the first enemy champion along its path, so check the route to your target. Even if you dismount from Skaarl, attack enemies to build Courage and look to remount. If you see the landing indicator for Pantheon R Grand Starfall, move out of its landing area.
Pantheon.watch: Pantheon W Shield Vault is a targeted stun, so you can't dodge it while in range. When Pantheon E Aegis Assault is active, stop attacking from the front and wait it out or move around to the side.

Riven.laning: Look to trade when Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope is ready. When it isn't, use Kled E Jousting to pull the wave and keep it on your side. Don't start a fight if Skaarl is very low on health. If you win a trade, pressure the turret to extend your advantage.
Riven.build: All of Riven's damage is physical, so build armor first. If Riven gets ahead, prioritize armor items earlier, and build enough health to avoid being finished off by Riven R Blade of the Exile.
Riven.combo: When Riven Q Broken Wings is down, close in with Kled E Jousting and land Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope. Keep attacking with Kled W Violent Tendencies and stay close until the trap's pull triggers, then finish with the fourth attack. If Riven tries to escape with her remaining mobility, recast Kled E Jousting toward the target it already hit to follow her.
Riven.escape: The window to engage is before Riven Q Broken Wings comes back up. Check whether Riven E Valor is also down, then close the gap with Kled E Jousting and land Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope. If Riven W Ki Burst is still available, watch for a stun immediately after you approach.
Riven.fight: When Riven Q Broken Wings is used to clear minions, get Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope ready and retaliate. After landing the trap, use Kled E Jousting to stay close, trigger the pull, and get in Kled W Violent Tendencies' fourth attack.
Riven.phase: Kled is strong in early trades, and the window after Riven Q Broken Wings is used to clear minions is a good time to act. Kled should turn his lane and midgame skirmish advantages into turret and objective pressure. In late-game teamfights, his sustained damage weakens after Skaarl leaves, so play to close out the game before it drags on.
Riven.teamfight: Use Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! along a path your allies can follow, and account for it charging at the first enemy champion along the route. Use the shield it grants during the charge to absorb damage just after engaging. Even if Skaarl leaves, attack nearby enemies to build Courage and look to remount, but watch out for Riven R Blade of the Exile when your health is low.
Riven.watch: If both Riven Q Broken Wings and Riven E Valor are available, she can use consecutive dashes to get in or escape beyond Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope's range. When you see the first dash, back away. While Riven R Blade of the Exile is active, watch for its increased range and damage based on your missing health, and retreat until it ends.

Chogath.build: Start with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Prioritize magic resistance against the magic damage from Cho’Gath Q Rupture, W Feral Scream, and E Vorpal Spikes, and fit Maw of Malmortius between your core items. If Cho’Gath P Carnivore’s healing makes him hard to kill even after Kled W Violent Tendencies’ fourth hit, build Executioner’s Calling earlier.
Chogath.combo: Dodge Cho’Gath Q Rupture, close in with Kled E Jousting, and land Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope. Stay close and keep attacking with Kled W Violent Tendencies; after the trap pulls him in, finish with the fourth hit. Account for the fact that Kled E Jousting’s recast only goes toward the target it first hit.
Chogath.escape: Look for an opening right after Cho’Gath Q Rupture is used on the wave or misses. If Cho’Gath W Feral Scream is also down, close in with Kled E Jousting and land Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope. Cho’Gath has no mobility spell to create distance once he is caught.
Chogath.fight: Fight when Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope is ready and you have dodged Cho’Gath Q Rupture. Avoid the front of Cho’Gath W Feral Scream, then close in with Kled E Jousting. Stay close until the trap pulls and land Kled W Violent Tendencies’ fourth hit. If Skaarl is low on health, do not start a trade.
Chogath.laning: Cho’Gath E Vorpal Spikes pass through minions, so step out of the line of his basic attacks. Pressure him after Cho’Gath Q Rupture is down, and extend a winning trade into Turret Plating. Account for Cho’Gath P Carnivore’s healing and his growing strength over time by pressuring the lane early.
Chogath.phase: Kled builds an early lead with strong trades and turret pressure. In the midgame, start skirmishes with Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! and get ahead through turrets and objectives. Cho’Gath gets stronger as he stacks, while Kled’s sustained damage falls off late, so a long game puts you at a disadvantage.
Chogath.teamfight: Use Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! along a path your allies can follow to engage together. Kled charges the first enemy champion along the route, so choose your target and path in advance, and use the charge shield to absorb damage right after engaging. Even if Skaarl leaves, attack enemies to build courage and try to remount, but keep your distance if your health is low enough for Cho’Gath R Feast to kill you.
Chogath.watch: When the ground warning for Cho’Gath Q Rupture appears beneath you, dodge sideways and save Kled E Jousting for this moment. Cho’Gath W Feral Scream silences you in front of him, preventing you from using mobility, so circle around to fight and walk out of the silence first if you are hit. If your health is at or below half, keep your distance to avoid the true damage from Cho’Gath R Feast.

Irelia.build: If Irelia Q Bladesurge’s healing keeps her alive even after Kled W Violent Tendencies’ fourth hit, rush Executioner's Calling. Build armor because Irelia P Ionian Fervor increases her attack speed and empowers her basic attacks.
Irelia.combo: When Irelia Q Bladesurge is down, hit her with Kled E Jousting, then use Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope. Stay close and keep attacking with Kled W Violent Tendencies, then finish the fourth hit after the trap’s pull triggers. If Irelia moves, follow with Kled E Jousting’s recast, which sends you toward the target you first hit.
Irelia.escape: The window to engage is right after you make Irelia use Irelia Q Bladesurge. If Irelia E Flawless Duet’s stun is also down, close the gap with Kled E Jousting and catch her with Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope.
Irelia.fight: Right after Irelia uses Irelia Q Bladesurge, engage with Kled E Jousting and land Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope. Stay close while the trap is active to trigger its pull, then get in Kled W Violent Tendencies’ fourth hit.
Irelia.laning: Do not leave low-health minions between you and Irelia. Avoid trading when Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope is unavailable or Skaarl is low on health. Extend a won fight by pressuring the turret.
Irelia.phase: In the late game, Kled’s sustained damage drops off if he is quickly dismounted after engaging, so snowball your midgame advantage.
Irelia.teamfight: Use Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! along a path your allies can follow to engage together, and prioritize Irelia. Plan your route knowing you charge the first enemy champion you encounter. Even if you are dismounted, keep attacking in the skirmish to build Courage and look to remount.
Irelia.watch: Irelia uses Irelia Q Bladesurge to dash to low-health minions, so create distance when minions are close to dying. Avoid the stun from Irelia E Flawless Duet. If trapped inside Irelia R Vanguard's Edge, wait for the blades to disappear.
